title: Quick Grilled Vietnamese Pork Bun Thit Nuong
description: Rich and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring grilled pork, this kid-friendly meal is perfect for any time of day, made with galangal and other ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and vegetable oil.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Grill the pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the baguette by grilling for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the buns by spreading a layer of pickled carrots on the bottom half of the baguette.
Add a few slices of the grilled pork on top of the pickled carrots.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and minced garlic on top of the pork.
Drizzle the remaining marinade over the top of the pork.
Top with the other half of the baguette.
